build_escnmd_backbone: build an eSCNMDBackbone model with configurable sphere channels, lmax, num layers, and execution mode for equivariant message passing
create_mlp_efs_head: create an MLP_EFS_Head to predict energy, forces, and stress via autograd derivatives from node embeddings
create_mlp_stress_head: create an MLP_Stress_Head to predict isotropic and anisotropic stress tensor components from node embeddings
create_linear_force_head: create a Linear_Force_Head using SO3_Linear to predict atomic forces from the L=1 vector component of node embeddings
create_linear_energy_head: create a Linear_Energy_Head to predict system energy by reducing node embeddings through a single linear layer
